Name: JojaGrowers - Contracts
Author: Sable17
Description:
[quote][size=4][b][color=#6d9eeb]JojaGrowers [/color][/b]- A program for local farmers to sell bulk vegetables at premium prices![/size][/quote]
[b][color=#6d9eeb]JojaMart [/color]is now looking for bulk vegetable suppliers![/b]

At the[b] back of [color=#6d9eeb]JojaMart [/color][/b]is the new [color=#6d9eeb][b]JojaGrowers Contract Board[/b][/color].

[b][color=#6d9eeb][size=4]JojaGrowers[/size][/color][/b]
• During the [b]first week[/b] of each [b]Season[/b],[b] [/b]you can sign a contract to [b]supply [color=#6d9eeb]JojaMart [/color]with Crops.
[/b]      ~ The contract will show up in your [b]quest journal.
[/b]       ~ You may choose to supply[b] 1, 2, or 3 crops [/b]for your contract [b]each season (Except Winter). [/b]Each requires [b]100 of the crop.[/b]
      ~ After selecting the crops you want to supply,[b] click/press A[/b] on "[b]Sign Here[/b]" to sign your contract.
      ~ After signing your contract, you can deposit your crops in the [b]crate next to the Board[/b] any time during the season.
      ﻿~ Partial deposits, and any quality of crop is accepted. [b]Quality [/b]and [b]Tiller [/b]profession is calculated and will result in a higher payout!

[size=4]You can choose [color=#6d9eeb][b]Original[/b][/color], or [color=#6d9eeb][b]Advanced [/b][/color]in the GMCM.[/size]
• [b]Original [/b]- Contracts available will be [b]base game vegetables [/b]only!
• [b]Advanced [/b]- Contracts available will be [b]randomly [/b]selected from [b]base game vegetables [/b]and whatever [b]mods [/b]you have installed that add vegetables!

[size=4]Upon [/size][b][size=4]completion [/size][/b][size=4]of your contract:[/size]
• You will receive the 110% of the total value of the crops. This is your starting [b][color=#6d9eeb]Premium Rate[/color][/b].
• Your [b][color=#6d9eeb]Premium Rate[/color][/b] multiplier will [b]increase [/b]by 10% (so next contract's [b][color=#6d9eeb]Premium Rate[/color][/b] will be [b]120%[/b], capped at [b]250%[/b]).

[size=4]If you sign a contract and [b]fail to deliver[/b]:[/size]
• Any crops already deposited are [u][b]forfeit[/b][/u]. You did [i]sign [/i]a contract after all... Don't preemptively deposit if you're not sure you'll make it.
• Your [b][color=#6d9eeb]Premium Rate[/color][/b] multiplier will [b]decrease [/b]by 10% (bottom capped at [b]100%[/b], so you'll never receive less than the crops are worth).

[size=4][b][color=#6d9eeb]JojaGrowers - Livestock Division[/color][/b][/size]
• An optional, additional [b]Board[/b] at which[b] [/b]you can sign a contract to [b]supply [color=#6d9eeb]JojaMart [/color]with [u]Animal Products[/u].
[/b]     ~ These contracts are available even in [b]Winter[/b]. Has its own [color=#6d9eeb][b]Premium Rate[/b][/color].
     ~ As with the main file, Quality and Rancher will increase payout!

You can choose [color=#6d9eeb][b]Original[/b][/color], or [color=#6d9eeb][b]Advanced [/b][/color]in the GMCM for this version as well!
• [b]Original [/b]- Contracts available will be [b]base game Animal Products [/b]only!
• [b]Advanced [/b]-  Contracts available will be [b]randomly [/b]selected from [b]base game Animal Products [/b]and whatever[b] mods [/b]you have installed that add  [b]Animal Products[/b]!

No reason not to shop while at your local JojaMart! Check out: 
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37717]JojaPantry [/url]for canned produce, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37365]JojaSweets Candy[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38012]JojaFizzy Energy Drinks[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37232]JojaBite TV Dinners [/url], or[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38341] JojaFresh Healthy Snacks[/url] for more Joja snacks!

For more flexible JojaJobs, try [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38103]JojaFlex - Freelance Contracts[/url].

There's also [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39109]JojaGrowth Fertilizer[/url] for your fields!
[b]
Requirements[/b]
• Stardew Valley 1.6+
• SMAPI

Not really compatible with:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28950]No More Lag[/url] - I place the [b]Boards[/b][b]/Bins[/b] dynamically on map load. No More Lag stops maps from loading normally. I recommend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37301?tab=description]SinZational Speedy Solutions[/url] for performance!

Doesn't directly edit the JojaMart map. Should be compatible with mods that edit the store, as long as they don't place anything in the same spot.
Compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded. (Used in Screenshots. Also in screenshot: Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn + SVE patch, VPR-Inspired UI, Peachy Objects, Soft Farmer, Cornucopia - More Crops)
